composition.title: Composition editor
composition.description: Plan focal points, subject coverage, and visual direction, then let the Agent choose the appropriate aesthetic refinement.

workflow.waitingMessage: The draft is ready for an Agent to inspect and submit an aesthetic refinement plan.
workflow.processingMessage: The Agent is deciding which composition treatment applies; the page does not select a method.
workflow.staleMessage: The draft changed, so the previous refinement no longer applies. Ask the Agent to reassess it.
workflow.errorMessage: The refinement is unavailable. Check the Agent output and drift-protection audit.
workflow.draftReadyMessage: The Agent refinement passed the drift-protection audit. You can inspect the result and generation reference.
workflow.referenceHint: This view suppresses styling and retains only the frame, shapes, focal points, and direction relationships for image generation.

composition.dragHint: Drag an element to move it; use arrow keys for precise movement and hold Shift to move faster.
